overview: A golem built of gold that mends the hurt around it and keeps nearby piglins calm.

1.1.1: Mod Menu's Donate button leads to sponsoring the author on GitHub. Nothing in play changes.
1.1.0: With Block Tip installed, looking at a gold golem shows how much gilt it has.
1.0.0: Build a gold golem like an iron one, out of blocks of gold.
Every five seconds it gives everyone hurt within six blocks Regeneration II: players, villagers, golems and tamed animals.
Each pulse costs one gilt. Gilt comes back by itself, one every thirty seconds, and gold nuggets and golden carrots top it up faster; right-click with an empty hand to see how much it has.

A body of its own, between the iron golem and the copper golem: the iron golem's nose, brow and red eyes, a wide head with a little bell on top, in smooth polished gold. About two thirds of an iron golem's height.
It rings a bell note when it mends.
Piglins leave alone anyone within sixteen blocks of one, as if they were wearing gold.
It stays near where it was built, or wherever you take its lead off.
A Gold Golem Spawn Egg, with the other spawn eggs.
Without Pandorical on your client, it looks like a small iron golem.
